categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Adds a functional test exercising P2P compact block relay and peer eviction protection logic in net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Adds functional test coverage for handling compact blocks received far ahead of the tip, preventing silent regressions in block download retries and peer eviction protection. The description notes that prior to this test, 'Two code paths in net_processing.cpp for handling far-ahead compact blocks had no test coverage. Either branch could be disabled or removed without causing test suite failures' (closing #34618).
